_howToPublishANewCompanionBuild: THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE YOU EDIT. Three steps, no hand-computed hashes:
1. Upload the new ZIP to  downloads/nerve/<version>-<channel>/  on GitHub.
Use a NEW folder every time. Never replace a file at a path already published.
2. In this file, set: version, channel, releaseDate, and companion.path.
On every deploy `npm run build` reads the actual ZIP and fills in the rest itself:
the SHA-256, the exact byte size, the human-readable size, the download URL and the
filename, then writes the matching .sha256 sidecar next to the ZIP. Because the hash
is computed from the very bytes being served, the published checksum can never drift
The build REFUSES to publish and fails loudly if: the ZIP named in companion.path is
missing, the version string does not appear in the filename, or a status is set to
'available' without the things that status requires. A failed build leaves the
previous deployment serving, so a mistake here cannot break the live site.
A download or Forge link is rendered as a real, clickable control ONLY when its
status is 'available' and its target actually exists. Otherwise it renders as a
non-clickable disabled control. Set a status back to 'pending' to unpublish;

_installVerified: The listing is public and the extension is assigned to Live with Data installation,
but a signed-in acquisition plus a Fantasy Grounds updater installation has NOT been
run end to end yet. While this is false the site says so plainly and does not claim
Forge installation has been validated. Set it to true only once that test has actually
passed — it removes the caveat from the downloads and setup pages.

_comment: The public Fantasy Grounds thread for Nerve. Used for 'Discussion and bug reports'.
Anything posted there is public: the feedback page tells reporters to redact personal
information, credentials and private campaign material, and to keep support bundles
out of public posts. Email stays available for private reports.
Set formEnabled to true ONLY after RESEND_API_KEY, FEEDBACK_TO and FEEDBACK_FROM
are set in the Vercel project's environment variables, AND the privacy page has been
updated to say where form submissions are stored. While it is false the feedback page
hides the form entirely and offers the forum and email routes instead.

_comment: Nerve support goes through the Forge listing's own donation/gift options. Do not add a
direct donation endpoint here and do not imply that donating is required or unlocks
anything. Buy Me a Coffee was removed from the Forge listing by the owner and is no
longer used for Nerve; any studio-wide support page is a separate matter.
